# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_mega_engineering.py". Edit the tables there and re-run.

# Self-removing province triggered modifiers that make random rolls for Mega Engineering.
# random / random_list repeat the same result outside on_actions, events and province triggered
# modifiers; on_activation fires once when the modifier is added, rolls, and removes the modifier.

DA_ME_core_driller_discovery = {
	potential = {
		always = yes
	}
	trigger = {
		always = yes
	}
	local_state_maintenance_modifier = 0.1
	on_activation = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Mine_8 }
			DA_Mine_upgrade_reward_8 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Mine_7 }
			DA_Mine_upgrade_reward_7 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Mine_6 }
			DA_Mine_upgrade_reward_6 = yes
		}
		remove_province_triggered_modifier = DA_ME_core_driller_discovery
	}
	on_deactivation = {
	}
}

DA_ME_mega_hold_discovery = {
	potential = {
		always = yes
	}
	trigger = {
		always = yes
	}
	local_state_maintenance_modifier = 0.1
	on_activation = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = dig_11 }
			hidden_effect = { Da_explore_dig_11_effect = yes }
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = { Da_explore_dig_10_effect = yes }
		}
		remove_province_triggered_modifier = DA_ME_mega_hold_discovery
	}
	on_deactivation = {
	}
}
